summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  ### What I found from a read-only pass (no code changed) I traced the full chain — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` tables — and, on paper, it looks correct: - Every fetch uses `credentials: "include"`; there's no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback anywhere in the watchlist code (only the theme toggle uses localStorage). - `watchlists.user_id` is `NOT NULL` and every query (`GET /`, `GET /:id`, item add/remove) filters by `user_id` der
